topic: Day 14 — carousel — A full calendar isn't the same as a full life

slides.text: A full [calendar] isn't a full life.
Busy and meaningful get confused constantly.
Time occupied isn't the same metric as time well spent.
Optimizing for the wrong variable just fills the hours.

caption:
A life can be completely packed with activity and still feel hollow if none of it connects to what matters. Occupied time and well-spent time are different metrics.

Follow for one of these a day.
